# ImportDefinitionAutoGenerateDestination

The ImportDefinitionAutoGenerateDestination object indicates destination of auto-generated data extension specified by import definition.

## Properties

| Name | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DataExtensionTarget | DataExtension | Indicates data extension to use as a template when auto-generating a new data extension. |
| ErrorIfExists | xsd:boolean | Indicates whether the API returns an error if a data extension already exists for an auto-generated process. |
